revisit_value.poi_restock_policy: outer caches restock; specimen vault one-time until world-state change

region_revisit_hooks.r_amberwood: Mill repair unlocks a plank route; old stored fruit becomes valuable after a fermentation recipe.
region_revisit_hooks.r_ashen_crown: Re-open the four legacy shortcuts; learn seal/power grammar at the buffer waystation before leaving the quarter.
region_revisit_hooks.r_ashwater_fen: Pump restoration changes safe channels; a bog-core specimen and a late-game purification loop.
region_revisit_hooks.r_ember_steppe: Fumarole cycles open obsidian seams; restore the old forge to refine higher cores.
region_revisit_hooks.r_frost_crown: Thaw-season veins, ice-cave cores and a high observatory that only powers after a thermal ward.
region_revisit_hooks.r_glasswind_coast: Tide-gated wrecks and a storm-warded signal tower; revisit after cap_stormward.
region_revisit_hooks.r_mirrormere: Drowned vault revealed by lowering a sluice; freshwater pearls and a ferry shortcut.
region_revisit_hooks.r_pearl_mangroves: Abyssal pearls in tide-locked grottoes; a floating outpost earns its keep by shortening the return leg.
region_revisit_hooks.r_saffron_coast: Caravan contracts, salt-pan harvesting after dry wind, and a harbor drydock for boats.
region_revisit_hooks.r_sunken_orchard: Cenote diving after cap_deepward; a grafting puzzle revalues Amberwood cuttings.
region_revisit_hooks.r_verdant_fold: Canopy temples, venom-core specimens and a root elevator opened by a living-wood puzzle.

scale_caveat: POI count and ideal straight crossing do not prove fourteen-day depth; these are bounded travel/preparation estimates only.
